candidates.text: The purpose of this enhancement is to support Size/Color-specific pricing for the same article in Multi-Style KIT Cost Sheets.
Since the Splitter functionality is not available for KIT Cost Sheets, users are unable to maintain different prices for the same article based on size.

Purpose:
1. The purpose of this enhancement is to support Size/Color-specific pricing for the same article in Multi-Style KIT Cost Sheets.
2. Currently, Single Style Cost Sheets provide a Splitter functionality that allows users to split the same article across sizes/colors while maintaining a single cost contribution using the Add to Cost option
3. Since the Splitter functionality is not available for KIT Cost Sheets, users are unable to maintain different prices for the same article based on size.
4. This enhancement provides an alternative solution by allowing duplicate articles in KIT Cost Sheets while ensuring only one occurrence contributes to the final costing.

Business Requirement:
1. Split the same article across different sizes.
2. Maintain different prices for each size or color
3. Mark only one split record as Add to Cost, ensuring the article is costed only once.
Different prices cannot be maintained for the same article.
Merchants are forced to use a common price across all sizes/colors

Business Requirement:
1. Different prices cannot be maintained for the same article.
2. Merchants are forced to use a common price across all sizes/colors
3. The calculated Material Cost becomes inaccurate.
4. Since Material Cost directly impacts EPM calculation, the displayed EPM becomes incorrect
5. Cost Sheet approvers rely on the EPM displayed on the UI during the approval process, making accurate EPM visibility a business-critical requirement.
An alternate proposal to provide EPM visibility through a BI Report was not accepted by the client, as the EPM must be visible directly on the Cost Sheet during approval.
This enhancement is a client-specific customization for Hyphen.

Assumptions:
1. This enhancement applies only to Multi-Style KIT Cost Sheets.
2. Existing functionality for Single Style Cost Sheets will remain unchanged.
3. Users may add the same article multiple times within a Multi-Style KIT Cost Sheet.
4. Duplicate articles may have different prices and different article tagging.
5. Only one duplicate article shall contribute towards cost calculation.
6. Existing article tagging functionality (Top/Bottom/Both) shall remain unchanged.
7. This enhancement is a client-specific customization for Hyphen.

Functional Requirement:
1. Create multiple entries for the same article.
2. Maintain different prices for different sizes and colors
3. Include only one occurrence in costing through the Add to Cost option.
This functionality is unavailable in Multi-Style KIT Cost Sheets.

Add to Cost Validation
Only one duplicate article may remain selected as Add to Cost = Yes.
Remaining duplicate articles shall be marked as Add to Cost = No.
During cost calculation, only the article marked as Add to Cost = Yes shall contribute towards Material Cost and EPM calculation.

Functional Requirement:

2. Only one duplicate article may remain selected as Add to Cost = Yes.
3. Remaining duplicate articles shall be marked as Add to Cost = No.
4. During cost calculation, only the article marked as Add to Cost = Yes shall contribute towards Material Cost and EPM calculation.

chunks.title: Purpose
chunks.heading: Purpose
chunks.text:
• The purpose of this enhancement is to support Size/Color-specific pricing for the same article in Multi-Style KIT Cost Sheets.
• Currently, Single Style Cost Sheets provide a Splitter functionality that allows users to split the same article across sizes/colors while maintaining a single cost contribution using the Add to Cost option
• Since the Splitter functionality is not available for KIT Cost Sheets, users are unable to maintain different prices for the same article based on size.
• This enhancement provides an alternative solution by allowing duplicate articles in KIT Cost Sheets while ensuring only one occurrence contributes to the final costing.

chunks.title: Business Requirement
chunks.heading: Business Requirement
chunks.text:
• Currently, the Splitter option is available only for Single Style Cost Sheets.
Using the Splitter, users can:
• Split the same article across different sizes.
• Maintain different prices for each size or color
• Mark only one split record as Add to Cost, ensuring the article is costed only once.
However, this functionality is unavailable in Multi-Style KIT Cost Sheets
As a result:
• Different prices cannot be maintained for the same article.
• Merchants are forced to use a common price across all sizes/colors
• The calculated Material Cost becomes inaccurate.
• Since Material Cost directly impacts EPM calculation, the displayed EPM becomes incorrect
• Cost Sheet approvers rely on the EPM displayed on the UI during the approval process, making accurate EPM visibility a business-critical requirement.
Multiple discussions were held with both the client and the internal product team. An alternate proposal to provide EPM visibility through a BI Report was not accepted by the client, as the EPM must be visible directly on the Cost Sheet during approval.
Since implementing the Splitter functionality within Multi-Style KIT Cost Sheets is not feasible, the agreed solution is to introduce controlled support for duplicate articles together with the ability to exclude duplicate entries from cost calculation using the Add to Cost option.

chunks.title: Business Requirement
chunks.heading: Business Requirement
chunks.text: This enhancement will be delivered as a Hyphen-specific customization.

chunks.title: Assumptions
chunks.heading: Assumptions
chunks.text:
• This enhancement applies only to Multi-Style KIT Cost Sheets.
• Existing functionality for Single Style Cost Sheets will remain unchanged.
• Users may add the same article multiple times within a Multi-Style KIT Cost Sheet.
• Duplicate articles may have different prices and different article tagging.
• Only one duplicate article shall contribute towards cost calculation.
• Existing article tagging functionality (Top/Bottom/Both) shall remain unchanged.
• This enhancement is a client-specific customization for Hyphen.

chunks.title: Functional Requirement
chunks.heading: Functional Requirement
chunks.text:
• Existing Behaviour
In Single Style Cost Sheets, users can utilize the Splitter functionality to:
• Create multiple entries for the same article.
• Maintain different prices for different sizes and colors
• Include only one occurrence in costing through the Add to Cost option.
This functionality is unavailable in Multi-Style KIT Cost Sheets.
• Proposed Functionality
The following functionality shall be introduced only for Multi-Style KIT Cost Sheets
Duplicate Article Support
Users shall be allowed to add the same article multiple times within a Multi-Style KIT Cost Sheet.
Each duplicate article may have:
• Different Price
• Different Consumption (if applicable)
• Different Article Tagging (Top / Bottom / Both)
Add to Cost Validation
When duplicate articles exist:
• The Add to Cost checkbox shall be editable only for duplicate articles.
• Only one duplicate article may remain selected as Add to Cost = Yes.
• Remaining duplicate articles shall be marked as Add to Cost = No.
• During cost calculation, only the article marked as Add to Cost = Yes shall contribute towards Material Cost and EPM calculation.
Cost Sheet Editing Restriction
To maintain consistency between the KIT Cost Sheet and the generated Style Cost Sheets:
• Only the KIT Cost Sheet shall remain editable.
• Style Cost Sheets generated from the KIT shall be read-only.
